mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.status,u.user_source,u.tel_phone, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.login_fail_num, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_name, d.dept_level, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status,d.ancestors, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status,u.pwd_update_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.password,u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar , u.phonenumber, u.status,u.pwd_update_time,u.tenant_id,u.user_type from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_name = #{userName}
select tenant_name from sys_tenant_info where tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select u.user_id,u.dept_id,u.tenant_id, u.user_name, u.password,u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.dept_id , u.phonenumber, u.status,u.pwd_update_time,u.user_type from sys_user u where u.user_name = #{userName} and u.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select DISTINCT u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password,u.enterprise_id, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.login_fail_num, u.user_type, u.tenant_id, u.is_tenant_admin, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_name, d.dept_level, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status,d.ancestors, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, dr.data_scope, r.status as role_status, t.tenant_name,t.tenant_desc,t.trade_info,t.province_id,t.county_id,t.city_id,u.tel_phone,u.pwd_update_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role_data_rel dr on dr.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_tenant_info t on u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status='0' AND u.user_name = #{userName} and ( r.trade_info = #{tradeId} or r.role_type='1')

select DISTINCT u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password,u.enterprise_id, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.login_fail_num, u.user_type, u.tenant_id, u.is_tenant_admin, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_name, d.dept_level, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status,d.ancestors, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, dr.data_scope, r.status as role_status, t.tenant_name,t.tenant_desc,t.trade_info,t.province_id,t.county_id,t.city_id,u.tel_phone,u.pwd_update_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role_data_rel dr on dr.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_tenant_info t on u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status='0' AND u.user_id = #{userId} and ( r.trade_info = #{tradeId} or r.role_type='1')

select distinct m.PERM_URL from sys_menu m INNER JOIN ( SELECT ria.role_id, ia.menu_id FROM sys_industry_auth ia INNER JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ria ON ia.auth_id = ria.auth_id WHERE ria.role_id = #{roleId} ) tmp ON m.menu_id = tmp.menu_id
mapper.update: update sys_user set password = #{password}, update_by = #{username}, update_time = current_timestamp() , pwd_update_time = current_timestamp() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select:
select
from sys_user where user_id=#{userId}

SELECT d.INDUSTRY_CODE, d.APP_VER_CODE, ic.industry_name, ic.img_url FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON d.INDUSTRY_CODE = ic.industry_code and ic.delete_flag = 0 WHERE FIND_IN_SET( d.DEPT_ID, #{deptIds}) and d.del_flag = '0'
and ic.accept_node = #{platformCode}
SELECT d.* FROM sys_dept d WHERE FIND_IN_SET( d.DEPT_ID, #{deptIds} ) AND d.INDUSTRY_CODE=#{industryCode} and d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT i.device_code AS deviceCode, i.device_name AS deviceName, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, i.province_id AS provinceId, a1.area_name AS provinceName , i.city_id AS cityId, a2.area_name AS cityName, i.county_id AS countyId, a3.area_name AS countyName FROM vm_device_info_t i LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t t ON t.device_code = i.device_code LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.dept_id = t.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a1 ON a1.AREA_CODE = i.province_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a2 ON a2.AREA_CODE = i.city_id LEFT JOIN sys_area a3 ON a3.AREA_CODE = i.county_id AND u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND i.province_id IS NOT NULL AND u.del_flag = '0' AND t.delete_flag = '0'
SELECT count(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_type = '2' AND u.is_tenant_admin = 1 AND u.USER_NAME = #{userName} ${dataScope}
select * from sys_area where area_code in (select street_area_code from sys_dept_street_rel where dept_id=#{deptId}) and area_code IS NOT NULL AND AREA_PARENT_CODE is not NULL

select sdsr.DEPT_ID, sdsr.STREET_AREA_CODE,sdsr.PROVINCE_CODE,sdsr.CITY_CODE from (select * from sys_dept WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} or PARENT_ID=#{deptId} ) a LEFT JOIN sys_dept_street_rel sdsr on a.DEPT_ID = sdsr.DEPT_ID

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptCode, d.DEPT_NAME AS deptName, d.parent_id AS parentdeptCode, d.order_num AS orderNum, d2.PROVINCE_CODE, d2.CITY_CODE, d2.COUNTY_CODE, d2.industry_code, d2.APP_VER_CODE FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_dept_street_rel d2 ON d.dept_id = d2.dept_id AND d.TENANT_ID = d2.TENANT_ID AND d.industry_code = d2.industry_code AND d.APP_VER_CODE = d2.APP_VER_CODE WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND d.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND d.APP_VER_CODE = #{appVerCode} AND EXISTS ( WITH recursive t1 ( dept_id, parent_id ) AS ( SELECT t0.dept_id, t0.parent_id FROM sys_dept t0 WHERE t0.dept_id = #{deptId} UNION ALL SELECT t2.dept_id, t2.parent_id FROM sys_dept t2, t1 WHERE t2.parent_id = t1.dept_id ) SELECT 1 FROM t1 WHERE t1.dept_id = d.DEPT_ID ) ORDER BY d.parent_id ASC, d.dept_id ASC, d.order_num ASC
SELECT user_id as userId, create_time as createTime FROM sys_auth_token_t where uuid=#{uuid} order by create_time desc limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_qr_t(code, status, create_time) values (#{code}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT status,create_time,user_id,app_login_node,token FROM sys_login_qr_t where code = #{code}
mapper.update:
update sys_login_qr_t
status = #{status},
user_id = #{userId},
app_login_node = #{appLoginNode},
token = #{token},
update_time = now()
where code = #{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_login_qr_t WHERE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) > create_time and status != '2'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_platform_switch_data(uuid, token, json, creator, create_time, delete_flag, refresh_token, extend) values (#{uuid}, #{token}, #{json}, #{creator}, now(), 0, #{refreshToken}, #{extend})
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, token, json, refresh_token, extend FROM vm_platform_switch_data WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.delete: UPDATE vm_platform_switch_data SET delete_flag = 1, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t2.accept_node FROM vm_order_customer t2 WHERE t2.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t2.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 )

SELECT wi.ip_start ipStart, wi.ip_end ipEnd FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN vm_white_ip wi ON u.user_id = wi.user_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.white_ip_flag = 1 AND wi.delete_flag = 0 AND u.user_name = #{username}
